Body.raw:
Add a LongSummary field to the todo record.

## What it is

A DERIVED field, in the same spirit as embeddings: a careful summary of the
Body, written in a format that will INFORM NOT OVERWHELM a human reader. It is
also the SOURCE for a summary embedding -- the expectation is that Body is too
long for most embedders to handle well, and that second use shapes how the
authoring agent writes it.

Not modelled on skills/pr-description: that format is tailored for FINISHED
work. The spirit (terse, reader-first, no padding) is consistent; the shape is
not.

## Permitted uses -- exactly two

1. Displaying to a user.
2. Generating a summary embedding.

Nothing else reads it. In particular it does NOT feed `prompt` (that output
goes to an agent, not a user, and would be a third use).

## No tool connection to Body

There is ZERO access control over this field beyond agents obeying the todo
SKILL, and NO tool-level coupling between Body and LongSummary. It is
COMPLETELY ALLOWED for an agent to set one without the other -- the motivating
case is a HICAP agent correcting a LongSummary written by a MIDCAP agent
without touching the Body. Therefore:

- doctor checks SHAPE only ({"raw": str} when present). It must NOT flag a
  LongSummary as stale, missing, or inconsistent with Body.
- Editing Body must NOT clear, drop, or regenerate LongSummary.
- Editing LongSummary clears only its OWN vectors, like any other raw field.

## Embeddings (ratified)

Additive: all of Summary, Body and LongSummary get embeddings. LongSummary is
expected to yield ONE phrase embedding because it is written exactly for that;
Body keeps its list of n-phrase embeddings. No special chunking machinery is
built here -- embedding generation and use are due for a strong revamp, so the
requirement this ticket carries is only that the SKILL tells the author to
write it AS IF IT WERE AN IMPORTANT EMBEDDING.

Registering the field in _EMBED_FIELDS (todo.py) and _EMBED_FIELD_PATHS
(todo_store.py) is sufficient: _embed_targets drives embed-on-write,
clear-vectors-on-change, search ranking and _changed_raw_fields off those
tables, so all of it follows.

## SKILL scope (ratified)

Add ONLY the SKILL aspects relevant to LongSummary, written IGNORANT of the
pending Summary->Title rename (todo:6299408b). Any other SKILL.md change --
including restructuring the file, which is now 1383 lines / 91KB / 18 sections
-- is OUT OF SCOPE. Report bloat observed; do not act on it.

## Fourth output: tool-offloadable invariants

While doing this work, collect invariants and processes currently carried by
the AGENT that could be offloaded to the TOOL -- the motivating example being
who decides the next action (work WorkItem x, advance state, ...): the agent
reasoning about it, or the tool computing it. Disposition by evidence, per the
user: zero findings -> drop; trivial -> fold into todo:6299408b; significant
-> its own todo.

LongSummary.raw:
Adds LongSummary to the todo record: an optional {raw} field holding a careful, reader-first summary of the Body, which doubles as the text the summary embedding is computed from. It exists because Body is usually too long for an embedder to handle well, so the summary vector is the one worth matching on.

The field is DERIVED but deliberately NOT coupled to Body by the tool. Either may be written without the other -- the motivating case is a HICAP agent rewriting a LongSummary a MIDCAP agent produced -- so editing Body never clears or flags LongSummary, editing LongSummary clears only its own vectors, and doctor validates shape only. doctor's silence about staleness is a decision, not an oversight, which means keeping the two in step is the agent's responsibility.

Implementation is small because the existing tables do the work: registering LongSummary in _EMBED_FIELDS and _EMBED_FIELD_PATHS gives embed-on-write, clear-on-change and search ranking through _embed_targets. Embedding is additive across Summary, Body and LongSummary; no chunking machinery was built, since embedding generation is due for a revamp and the requirement carried here is a SKILL authoring rule instead. The viewer needed dedicated rendering rather than the generic Fields path, which would have dumped the objid and the whole embedding array onto the page.

Most of the work is SKILL.md: the field, its exactly-two permitted uses (display to a human, and the embedding -- explicitly not prompt), the no-tool-connection rule, and a do/don't table for writing one, whose governing rule is to write it as if it were an important embedding. Scoped to LongSummary only and written ignorant of the pending Summary->Title rename.
